definitions.explanation: Trees with broad, flat leaves as opposed to needle-like leaves. Includes both deciduous and evergreen species.

examples.japanese: {広葉樹|こうようじゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{色|いろ}づきます→色づく：10074_irozuku⟧。
examples.english: Broadleaf forests change color in autumn.

examples.japanese: ⟦{欅|けやき}→欅：27424_keyaki⟧⟦や→や：10080_ya⟧⟦{楓|かえで}→楓：04375_kaede⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{広葉樹|こうようじゅ}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Zelkova and maple are broadleaf trees.

examples.japanese: {広葉樹|こうようじゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{木材|もくざい}→木材：13017_mokuzai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家具|かぐ}→家具：12314_kagu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}われます→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Hardwood from broadleaf trees is used for furniture.

notes:
{広葉樹|こうようじゅ} refers to trees with broad leaves, as opposed to ⟦{針葉樹|しんようじゅ}→針葉樹：04960_shinyouju⟧ (conifers).

{広|こう} = broad, {葉|よう} = leaf, {樹|じゅ} = tree

Common Japanese broadleaf trees:
- ⟦{欅|けやき}→欅：27424_keyaki⟧ (zelkova)
- ⟦{楓|かえで}→楓：04375_kaede⟧ (maple)
- ⟦{椎|しい}→椎：noentry⟧ (chinquapin)
- ⟦{楠|くすのき}→楠：noentry⟧ (camphor tree)
- ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧ (cherry)

Types:
- ⟦{落葉広葉樹|らくようこうようじゅ}→落葉広葉樹：noentry⟧ (deciduous broadleaf)
- ⟦{常緑広葉樹|じょうりょくこうようじゅ}→常緑広葉樹：noentry⟧ (evergreen broadleaf)

Broadleaf wood is generally harder, used for furniture and flooring.
